criteria.name: jsonl_correctness
criteria.description: JSON array and JSONL imports parse correctly, invalid JSONL reports useful errors, existing append field validation still works.

criteria.name: backend_performance
criteria.description: Large imports avoid obvious O(n) scans and single huge insert statements on the server hot path.

criteria.name: navigation_smoothness
criteria.description: Sidebar/mobile tab transitions use stable, low-cost styling and avoid hosted-only unnecessary failed requests.

criteria.name: regression_safety
criteria.description: Dataset tests, typecheck, and browser smoke pass with no request status >= 400 in the tested main flow.
